facts.fact: The New Dawn reports that police confirmed over the weekend before 21 September 2026 the arrest of Jerry Nyantee Wrotto under the Cybercrime Act for allegedly creating and sharing AI-generated images and videos of Vice President Koung; the Vice President asked for his immediate release and no court had ruled on the conduct.

systems.owner: Government of Liberia (signed by President Boakai on 2026-08-19)

note: Criticism of the arrest comes from individuals (a former minister, a lawyer), not a named paper, party, body or group, so no debate fact.
